title: Is America really that polarized? The answer might be a surprise
summary: The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.
contentText:
The U.S. has become more politically polarized, but research shows people overestimate their differences and there is 'messy middle' majority of Americans who share overlapping political views.

(Image credit: Stephen Maturen/Getty Images)
